describes: packages/core/signature: sign() and validateSignatures() over a document handle's signatures service.

cases.name: sign-no-service
cases.covers: An engine without signatures refuses at once.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: this engine does not implement signatures

cases.name: sign-raw-cades
cases.covers: prepare with CAdES and the signer's hash, build, gate, complete.

cases.name: sign-raw-pkcs7
cases.covers: The PKCS#7 sub-filter builds with signing-time from the clock.

cases.name: sign-raw-sha384
cases.covers: A raw signer's hash is the prepared digest when none is asked for.

cases.name: sign-cms-signer
cases.covers: A CMS signer gets the digest, algorithm and sub-filter; sha256 unless asked.

cases.name: sign-explicit-digest
cases.covers: An explicit digest is passed to prepare as is.

cases.name: sign-gate-refuses
cases.covers: A CMS the gate refuses aborts the signing and rejects with SigningError.

$error.name: SigningError
$error.message: signing refused (algorithm-mismatch): the CMS digests with sha384, the document was prepared with sha256

cases.name: sign-signer-rejects
cases.covers: A signer failure aborts and rethrows.

cases.name: sign-complete-rejects
cases.covers: A failed complete aborts and rethrows the engine error.

cases.name: sign-abort-rejects
cases.covers: An abort that fails is swallowed; the original error wins.

$error.name: SigningError
$error.message: signing refused (malformed): CMS has 2 signers; exactly one is expected

cases.name: sign-prepare-rejects
cases.covers: A failed prepare rejects without an abort.

cases.name: sign-raw-sha1-prepared
cases.covers: A raw signer over a document prepared with SHA-1 is refused by the build.

cases.name: sign-build-throws
cases.covers: A raw signer whose build throws aborts.

cases.name: validate-no-service
cases.covers: An engine without signatures refuses.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: this engine does not implement signatures

cases.name: validate-empty
cases.covers: No signatures, no verdicts.

cases.name: validate-valid-untrusted
cases.covers: Intact, verifying, no trust port, sealing the last revision: `valid-untrusted`, unchanged.

cases.name: validate-trusted
cases.covers: With an anchor that validates: `valid`.

cases.name: validate-untrusted-reason
cases.covers: A chain that fails carries its reason.

cases.name: validate-digest-mismatch
cases.covers: Bytes that do not hash to the message digest: integrity invalid.

cases.name: validate-partial-coverage
cases.covers: Partial coverage is invalid even when the digest matches.

cases.name: validate-chain-invalid
cases.covers: A broken revision chain makes integrity indeterminate without reading the CMS.

cases.name: validate-signed-by-truthiness
cases.covers: Only a truthy `signed` is judged, whatever its type: null, 0 and the empty string are skipped; 1, a string, an object and an array are not.

cases.name: validate-coverage-malformed
cases.covers: Malformed coverage on a valid chain is invalid.

cases.name: validate-unsupported-cms
cases.covers: A CMS this engine cannot read is indeterminate, not tampering.

cases.name: validate-malformed-cms
cases.covers: A malformed CMS is invalid.

cases.name: validate-contents-rejects
cases.covers: An engine failure reading the CMS is indeterminate.

cases.name: validate-crypto-invalid
cases.covers: A signature that does not verify is invalid.

cases.name: validate-crypto-unsupported
cases.covers: An unsupported algorithm is indeterminate.

cases.name: validate-no-revision
cases.covers: A signature that seals no whole revision has indeterminate modifications.

modifications.detail: the signature seals no whole revision

cases.name: validate-forbidden
cases.covers: A forbidden change after the signature: invalid, with the object and rule.

cases.name: validate-forbidden-no-detail
cases.covers: A forbidden primary without detail.

cases.name: validate-incomplete
cases.covers: An incomplete primary: indeterminate, with its detail.

cases.name: validate-incomplete-no-detail
cases.covers: An incomplete primary without detail says so.

cases.name: validate-permitted-undone
cases.covers: Permitted later changes, some undone; the working copy was asked for.

cases.name: validate-analyze-rejects
cases.covers: A failed analysis is indeterminate with its message.
